purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: Otsu City conducts cadastral surveys and publishes survey-implementation maps. Its official My Town map-service page explicitly says it does not include parcel-number (地番図) map information; certificates/records are handled through specific application channels. No public parcel feature endpoint or geometry was found. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
